race.title: Book A Table For New Years Day Mares Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: WESTIN PIMPERNEL still looked a work in progress when gaining a first win for Gordon Elliott at Punchestown and can defy a 7 lb weights rise to go 2-3 since joining her new yard. Handicap debutant Dromana Mist rates the obvious danger in her hat-trick bid, while Leading Rose , Miss Lia and Mastertown Miss all need factoring in too. WESTIN PIMPERNEL (IRE) DROMANA MIST (IRE) LEADING ROSE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Westin Pimpernel (5/2), Dromana Mist (11/4), Onefortheditch (6/1), Maxios Prime (8/1), Mastertown Miss (8/1), Mount Shenshan (8/1), Clash Gold (10/1), Leading Rose (14/1), French Adventure (16/1), Miss Lia (25/1), Coillte M C G (25/1), Lep Around (100/1)
